name: Line chart
blurb: Plot one or more series over a category axis. Supports smooth (spline) and stepped lines.
docProps: Series objects ([name, data]) or a flat list of numbers.
Render a smooth spline instead of straight segments.
Render a stepped line (start, middle or end).
Stack series on top of each other.

name: Area chart
blurb: A filled line chart, ideal for showing volume over time. Stack series for cumulative totals.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Column chart
blurb: Vertical bars for comparing values across categories. Stack to compare composition.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Bar chart
blurb: Horizontal bars — perfect for ranked lists and long category labels.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Pie chart
blurb: Show parts of a whole. Pass flat values with labels, or pre-shaped data objects.
docProps: Slice labels (when series is a flat list).
Render as a Nightingale rose chart.

name: Scatter chart
blurb: Plot raw [x, y] points to reveal correlations and clusters.

name: Spline with symbols
blurb: A smooth line where each series is marked with a distinct point symbol — circle, square, triangle, diamond and more.
docProps: Series objects ([name, data]) or a flat list of numbers.

name: Spline with inverted axes
blurb: A smooth line with the category axis running vertically — ideal for profiles such as temperature by altitude.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.
Labels for the vertical category axis.

name: Line with end labels
blurb: Labels each series at the end of its line instead of using a legend.

name: Logarithmic axis
blurb: A line chart with a logarithmic y-axis for values spanning several orders of magnitude.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Line race
blurb: An animated line race that reveals each series progressively, with a replay control.

name: Entrance animation
blurb: A line chart with a custom entrance animation — configurable easing and a staggered per-point delay.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Forecast
blurb: Draws actual values solid and forecast values as a dashed line over a shaded region.
docProps: The predicted values continuing after actual.

name: Annotations
blurb: Labelled annotation pins on chosen points, plus an optional average reference line.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Large datasets
blurb: Tuned for very large datasets with LTTB downsampling and zoom/pan controls.
docProps: Series ([name, data]); data can be huge.

name: Time series
blurb: A line over a datetime axis. Data points are [date, value] pairs, with zoom/pan.

name: Spline (irregular time)
blurb: A smooth spline over an irregular datetime axis with visible measurement points.

name: Plot bands
blurb: A spline with coloured horizontal plot bands marking value zones.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Gradient area
blurb: A smooth area chart where each series fades from its colour to transparent. Optionally stacked.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Stacked area
blurb: Filled series stacked on top of one another to show cumulative totals and composition.

name: Percentage area
blurb: A 100% stacked area chart showing each series as a percentage of the total.

name: Area spline
blurb: A smooth area chart with semi-transparent overlapping fills.

name: Inverted area
blurb: A filled area chart with the category axis running vertically.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.
Labels for the vertical category axis.

name: Negative values
blurb: An area chart whose line and fill are coloured differently above and below zero.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Missing points
blurb: Handles null values — leaving a gap, or bridging it with connectNulls.
docProps: Series objects; use null for gaps.
Bridge gaps instead of breaking the line.

name: Area range
blurb: A filled band between a low and high value per category (e.g. min/max ranges).

name: Range with line
blurb: A low/high band with a line (e.g. the average) drawn on top.

name: Fan chart
blurb: A central line surrounded by nested confidence bands — ideal for forecasts with uncertainty.

name: Area race
blurb: An animated area race that reveals each filled series progressively, with a replay control.

name: Streamgraph
blurb: A flowing stacked area displaced around a central baseline (themeRiver).

name: Stacked & inverted
blurb: A stacked area chart with inverted axes (category axis vertical).
docProps: Labels for the vertical category axis.

name: Stacked column
blurb: Vertical bars stacked to show cumulative totals and composition.

name: Stacked bar
blurb: Horizontal bars stacked to show cumulative totals.

name: Percentage column
blurb: A 100% stacked column chart showing each series as a percentage of the total.

name: Percentage bar
blurb: A 100% stacked horizontal bar chart.

name: Negative columns
blurb: Columns coloured differently for positive and negative values.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Rotated labels
blurb: A column chart with rotated category labels — handy for many or long labels.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.

name: Column range
blurb: Floating vertical bars from a low to a high value per category.

name: Bar range
blurb: Floating horizontal bars from a low to a high value.

name: Histogram
blurb: Bins a flat list of numeric values into frequency columns.
docProps: A flat list of numeric values.

name: Lollipop
blurb: A thin stick topped with a circular marker for each value.

name: Pareto
blurb: Columns sorted descending with a cumulative percentage line on a second axis.

name: Line & column
blurb: Mixed line and column series sharing one axis. Each series sets a friendly type.
docProps: Series with a 'type' of bar, line or area.

name: Dual axes
blurb: Series split across a left and right y-axis — e.g. rainfall and temperature.
docProps: Names for the left and right axes.

name: Multiple axes
blurb: Series spread across three or more y-axes for very different scales.

name: Regression line
blurb: A scatter plot with a least-squares linear trend line.
docProps: A single series of [x, y] points.

name: Multi-symbol scatter
blurb: A multi-series scatter where each series uses a distinct point symbol.

name: Packed bubble
blurb: Force-packed bubbles sized by value and grouped by category.

name: Semi-circle
blurb: A donut whose slices fill the top half of the ring.

name: External labels
blurb: A pie with external data labels connected by leader lines.

name: Monochrome
blurb: Slices coloured in shades of a single hue.

name: Gradient
blurb: A pie whose slices are filled with radial gradients.

name: Variable radius
blurb: A pie where each slice's radius encodes its value.

name: Nightingale rose
blurb: A rose chart where each slice's area encodes its value.

name: Donut chart
blurb: A pie with a hole — great for a headline metric in the center.

name: Funnel chart
blurb: Visualize a pipeline: each stage as a shrinking segment.

name: Gauge chart
blurb: Show a value against a range with a classic needle or a progress ring.
docProps: Use a progress ring instead of a needle.

name: Clock
blurb: An animated analog clock built from gauges. The hour, minute and second hands advance live every second.
docProps: Color of the second hand (defaults to the accent).

name: Bubble chart
blurb: A scatter chart where a third value drives each point's size.

name: Heatmap
blurb: A grid of cells colored by value — ideal for activity and density data.
docProps: Value mapped to the most intense color.

name: Candlestick
blurb: OHLC financial data as candlesticks over a time axis.

name: Box plot
blurb: Summarize distributions with min, quartiles and max.

name: Radar chart
blurb: Compare multiple variables on a circular axis.
docProps: Series with a value per indicator.

name: Tree
blurb: Render hierarchical data as an expandable node tree.

name: Treemap
blurb: Nested rectangles sized by value — dense and space-efficient.

name: Sunburst
blurb: A radial treemap for multi-level hierarchies.

name: Sankey
blurb: Flow diagrams where link width encodes magnitude.

name: Network graph
blurb: Force-directed nodes and edges for relationship data.

name: 3D bar chart
blurb: A bar chart across two category axes, rendered in 3D.
docProps: Adds a color scale capped at this value.

name: 3D scatter
blurb: Plot [x, y, z] points in three-dimensional space.

name: 3D surface
blurb: A continuous 3D surface from a grid of [x, y, z] points.

name: Audio chart
blurb: A line chart that can be played as sound. Pitch maps to value, time to the x-axis — with a screen-reader summary.
docProps: Series objects or a flat list of numbers.
